page.overview:
Who is Bison Troopers?

The Bison Troopers or Bison Shock Troops are characters from the 1994 Street Fighter movie and the fighting game Street Fighter: The Movie. They serve as General M. Bison's soldiers and security against the forces of the Allied Nations. In the arcade version of Street Fighter: The Movie, four Bison Troopers, Blade, Arkane, Khyber and F7 were included as playable characters (though only Blade was playable from the start, and the rest were hidden characters).

These troopers were solely created for the game and they (with Blade technically being the sole exception) have not appeared in any other Street Fighter game or medium since their debut until they were given profiles and new artwork on the official Street Fighter V website. In their profiles, they are the , skilled combatants that are part of Shadaloo's North American branch.

The body armor and characteristics of the Bison Troops were heavily based on the fictional Stormtroopers from the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_original_trilogy Star Wars original trilogy] such as episode's [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_(film) IV], [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Empire_Strikes_Back V] & [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Return_of_the_Jedi VI], with their dictatorial leader General Bison playing both the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Darth_Vader Darth Vader] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Palpatine Palpatine] roles; as well as being heavily inspired by the non-fictional Nazï Troopers during the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_War_II World War II] era, the Bison Troops even salute in a Nazï-esque fashion.

The Bison Troops canonically wear blue uniforms, even in the 1995 anime series Street Fighter II V; but their outfits were changed to red to match the uniform of Bison, Zangief and Dee Jay; while leaving the color blue to Guile, Cammy, T. Hawk, Charlie, and other A.N. Troops.
